subject.title: No guard against skill repos created outside canonical paths

question: Should OpenClaw add off-root `SKILL.md` orphan detection, and should it run in `openclaw skills check`, Doctor, startup/status, or docs-only guidance?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but scanning outside configured roots is a privacy, performance, false-positive, and operator-noise product choice rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
options.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with configured-root exclusions and remediation to move, install, or configure the skill.

options.title: Startup Or Status Warning
options.body: Surface the same warning during startup/status as well, accepting additional runtime scanning and operator-visible noise.

options.title: Document Current Scope Only
options.body: Keep OpenClaw limited to configured roots and improve docs rather than adding off-root filesystem scanning.

recommendation.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
recommendation.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with configured-root exclusions and remediation to move, install, or configure the skill.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature-history trail across skill creation, Skill Workshop, and lifecycle curation where the diagnostic product boundary should be decided.
